criteria.description: Domain exposes subject-neutral SBOM subjects, manifests, manifest packages, publish states, and source kinds while preserving existing ArtifactSBOM and SBOMPackage behavior.

Database migrations create and roll back generalized sbom_manifests and sbom_manifest_packages projections with subject, storage, generator, Nostr publish state, package index, and dedupe constraints.
Repository methods can insert/dedupe/list SBOM manifests, update publish state, search manifest packages, and preserve artifact compatibility projections for artifact subjects.
